settings.howTo: How to get a free key
howToSteps: Open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with a Google account.
Accept the terms – Google AI Studio creates a project and a key for you (no card needed for the free tier).
Copy the key (it starts with “AIza”) and paste it above.
You can see the free-tier limits in AI Studio. When they are reached, the app will ask you to try again later.

info.title: AI in Przystań
info.lead: AI is optional and off by default. While it is off, the app makes no network requests at all.

sections.q: What is processed on the device?
sections.a: In Local mode everything: semantic search (e5 model), dictation (Whisper) and – if you download it – a small language model (Qwen3 via WebLLM). Models are downloaded once and then work offline. The search index (including your notes) is encrypted together with your data.

Only in Cloud mode and only: the app's expert content (knowledge cards, flashcards, scenarios), your answers in the simulator and the exam, and study texts you paste yourself. Notes, client profiles, meetings, diagnoses, results and supervision are never sent automatically.

sections.q: And data about the people I work with?
sections.a: On the device only by default. If you allow sending in the settings, the text is pseudonymised first (names, dates, addresses, phone numbers, PESEL/AHV, names of facilities → placeholders), you see exactly what will be sent and agree to each request separately. Placeholders are restored on the device.

According to the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service (effective 23 March 2026, checked 4 November 2026), for users in the EEA, Switzerland and the UK the paid-service rules also apply to the free tier: Google does not use prompts or responses to improve its products. Even so, Przystań does not send personal data. The key is yours – you use the Gemini API in your own name under Google's terms.

It does not diagnose, does not assess risk (suicide, violence, relapse) and does not replace supervision. Every answer is marked “Auxiliary – verify”. When a text suggests danger, the app shows crisis numbers.

sections.q: How do I turn AI off and delete the models?
sections.a: Settings → AI assistant → mode “Off”. There you can also remove the key and the downloaded models (“Delete all models”).

practice.title: Good-practice check
practice.fear: Scare tactics (e.g. “death”, “you will ruin your life”) – they do not work in prevention and can backfire.
practice.exUser: An ex-user's testimony as the main method – good practice advises against such one-off talks.
practice.oneOff: A one-off talk / lecture – effective programmes are interactive and spread over time.
practice.info: Detailed information about substances and ways of use – it can raise curiosity; focus on skills and norms instead.
practice.moral: Moralising instead of building skills – replace it with exercises (refusal, coping with emotions).

supervision.title: Questions for supervision
